name: ai-scraping-executor
description: AI Web Scraping Executor — plataforma agnóstica de scraping asistida por IA (Crawlee + NestJS)

scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @ai-scraper/core && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/commands && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/crawler && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/execution-engine && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/ai && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/ai-providers
scripts.test: node --test tests/dsl.test.mjs tests/engine.test.mjs tests/crawler.test.mjs tests/ai-providers.test.mjs tests/agent.test.mjs tests/persistence.test.mjs tests/dashboard.test.mjs
